english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial noun for the time between sunrise and sunset.

exampleSentences.english: It’s so hot in the daytime, so remember to drink more water.
exampleSentences.traditional: 日頭咁熱，記得飲多啲水。
exampleSentences.jyutping: jat6 tau4 gam3 jit6 gei3 dak1 jam2 do1 di1 seoi2

english.note: Use this colloquial noun for the daytime period rather than for the light itself.

exampleSentences.english: It's still daylight, so there's no need to turn on the lights so early.
exampleSentences.traditional: 而家仲係日頭，唔使咁早開燈。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ji4 gaa1 zung6 hai6 jat6 tau4 m4 sai2 gam3 zou2 hoi1 dang1
